sourceProjection.basis: Page 23 reproduces the dated September 2013 El Born Centre Cultural visitor diagram as an undistorted top-down schematic. Its vector paths separately encode the public-space fill, four named rooms, three archaeological-site panels, entrance arrows and room borders.

review: The 8 September 2013 Presencia page was inspected at native PDF vector resolution. Its El Born Centre Cultural diagram and 1-7 legend match the search-indexed official planol-catala.pdf graphic, whose legacy official URL now redirects instead of returning PDF bytes. This pinned republication is historical visitor evidence, not a current measured architectural survey. Exact PDF path bounds provide the public-space and room faces; red outline paths remain flat detail. Printed identifiers remain semantic labels and are not included in geometry.
limitations: 本图为 2013 年 9 月开馆时期访客示意图，不代表 2024–2026 年改展后的现状布局或开放状态。
公共空间、1–4 号功能室与三块 5 号遗址范围按原 PDF 矢量边界保留；示意比例不等同测绘精度。
红色房间框、遗址点线和入口箭头均保持平面细节，不挤出为实体墙。
地下遗址内部街巷、住宅、排水线、高差与下行路线没有在此图中绘出，不补造。
桑树墓园、博恩大道与通往巴塞罗内塔的室外路线不在本平面范围内。
unresolved: 2024 年改造之后各展厅的 2026 年现状边界、名称与开放状态。
地下考古遗址内部街巷、住宅、排水线、参观平台与竖向交通正投影。
卫生间、电梯、楼梯及无障碍路线的准确平面位置。
官方原始 planol-catala.pdf 与 2018 教育访问图的旧网址现重定向；Internet Archive 精确与通配 CDX 检索于 2026-09-05 均返回暂时离线，因此本候选使用可哈希的 2013 同图刊物转载。

research.result: Official search index exposes the same numbered 1-7 visitor plan and legend, but the legacy URL now redirects to the museum homepage rather than returning the original PDF bytes.
Used: pinned September 2013 publication page 23 reproduces the official visitor plan as inspectable PDF vectors with the complete 1-7 legend.
Official search index exposes a later educational visit map with the same 1-7 semantics; its legacy URL also redirects and did not return a pin-able plan file.
Investigated and rejected as building geometry: the February-May 2024 top-down graphic is a future program/narrative scheme, not a visitor architectural floor plan.

Queried on 2026-09-05 together with exact legacy-domain and wildcard Barcelona-host variants. Internet Archive returned its Temporarily Offline page for every CDX request, so no archived official PDF bytes were obtained and no archive result is claimed.

rules.reason: Exact reviewed PDF vectors for the visitor-diagram perimeter, four room borders, three dotted archaeology boundaries and two entrance arrows; these are schematic flat details, not extruded walls.
